name: Tile / Collapsible Workspace
description: Collapsible Workspace product scenario for the Tile component.

controls.name: text
controls.description: Primary label.

controls.name: rightText
controls.description: Optional secondary text at the far right of the label area.

controls.name: variant
controls.description: Visual variant.

controls.name: intent
controls.description: Semantic row intent. Use default for generic and navigation rows, disclosure for parent rows, tree for nested project rows, tab for tab controls, and section for non-interactive headings.

controls.name: density
controls.description: Internal spacing density. Default follows the shared control rhythm; spacious gives inspection rows more breathing room.

controls.name: tone
controls.description: Semantic visual tone for row foreground and hover treatment.

controls.name: actionVisibility
controls.description: How the actions slot is exposed: reveal on hover/focus/active, hover only, always visible, or hidden.

controls.name: icon
controls.description: Icon (string from registry or ReactNode).

controls.name: iconPosition
controls.description: Icon position relative to text.

controls.name: leading
controls.description: Isolated leading slot for nested controls. Use icon for decorative icons and leading for actionable controls.

controls.name: meta
controls.description: Trailing non-interactive metadata rendered before actions.

controls.name: disabled
controls.description: Disabled state.

controls.name: busy
controls.description: Marks the row busy with data-busy and aria-busy without disabling it by itself.

controls.name: active
controls.description: Active / selected state.

controls.name: selectedDescendant
controls.description: Marks parent rows that contain the selected descendant, commonly while collapsed.

controls.name: interactive
controls.description: Override interactive semantics. Set false for section/header rows that should not expose button behavior.

controls.name: stretchText
controls.description: Stretch text area (flex:1).

controls.name: selector
controls.description: Render a compact selector indicator after the label.

controls.name: selectorOpen
controls.description: Open state for the selector indicator.

controls.name: fullWidth
controls.description: Full width tile.

controls.name: align
controls.description: Text alignment.

controls.name: level
controls.description: Nesting level for option-like rows: 0..9

controls.name: truncate
controls.description: Truncate overflowing text content with ellipsis.

controls.name: membrane
controls.description: Membrane spacing around the tile.

controls.name: actions
controls.description: Nested action buttons. Rendered at the far right; their clicks do not bubble to the tile.

controls.name: children
controls.description: Custom children (overrides text/icon rendering).
